title: mcp: validate_expression answers ok for a validation that the save/publish gate then refuses (a relationship read as both a record and a value)
body:
Filing category: ① product defect.
reach: public entries — `/api/v1/mcp` `tools/call validate_expression` (answered ok) and package publish (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts`, refused `expression-invalid`); measured once on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## Business reason

`validate_expression` exists so an agent checks a rule before authoring it; its description says to pass the site and severity "so the verdict is the one the publish gate gives that rule". When it says ok and the gate refuses, the agent reports a rule as done, and the refusal first appears when a person publishes — after the agent has finished.

## Steps

1. Object `rtbw_leave_req` with a lookup `balance` → `rtbw_leave_bal` (which has a formula `remaining`).
2. `validate_expression { objectName: 'rtbw_leave_req', site: 'validation', expression: "record.leave_type == 'annual' && record.days > record.balance.remaining" }` → `ok: true, errors: [], warnings: []`.
3. Author it as a `script` validation guarded the natural way: `has(record.balance) && record.leave_type == "annual" && record.days > record.balance.remaining` (also ok-able by step 2's tool).
4. Publish → refused: `expression-invalid` "`record.balance` is read BOTH through the relationship (`record.balance.<related field>`) and as a plain value (`record.balance`) in the same expression … make it the `then` of a `conditional` rule whose `when` is `record.balance != null`."

The refusal text is excellent; following it (a `conditional` rule) publishes, and the rule then refuses an over-balance request at runtime as intended.

## Expected

`validate_expression` with `site: 'validation'` runs the same `expression-invalid` checks as the save/publish gate (including the relationship-read-twice rule), so its verdict and the gate's agree.

Reader who acts: the seat that owns `packages/mcp` `validate_expression` and the shared expression lint it should call.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue validate_expression publish expression-invalid relationship` → 4 hits (#29002, #27438, #28656; QA run records), none on this disagreement; #28715 (closed) is a different validate_expression/door disagreement (`label()` on a field without options).
